title: Chart Is a Real Image
description: A screen reader can't see an SVG bar chart's shapes — it needs the chart to describe itself in words. Confirm both charts are properly labeled as images with a real data summary.
successCondition: On /reporting with data present, both bar chart <svg> elements have role="img" and an aria-label containing every rendered bucket's label and formatted value in a readable "label value, label value" pattern — not just a generic title like "chart".
hints: The aria-label is built directly from the same bars array driving the visual rendering (BarChart.tsx) — cross-check its text against what's on screen.
There are two separate chart figures (shipment volume and revenue) — check both aria-labels independently, since they summarize different data.
